exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

leads_by_tag._scope: Scope: currently-open opportunities in (1) PROJECT: Lead Qualification + (2) PROJECT: Sales Pipeline (208 records), matching lead_count. lead: lost and lead: rate-shopper show 0 here because none of today's OPEN population carries them — they exist among closed (won/lost/abandoned) records, out of scope for this active snapshot.

opportunity_status_counts._scope: (1) PROJECT: Lead Qualification + (2) PROJECT: Sales Pipeline combined, all-time (not window-scoped). STORE: Material Pipeline counted separately in store_pipeline_note.

reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline (retail material, distinct from project work): 50 open opportunities across its stages, mostly parked in '3. +8d - Final Follow-up (Auto)' (26 open, some dating back to July 2025 with no threshold defined for this pipeline — volume only, no staleness predicted). Data-quality flag: 13 of 17 opportunities sitting in the '6a. Closed - Won' stage still carry status=open rather than won — a labeling gap between stage and status, not a stale/abandon issue.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
